variants.name: Handcart
variants.solidity: solid (static prop; can be a physics prop)
variants.collider: box for the body (1.3 x 1.4 x 0.6 at floor level), 2 thin boxes/cylinders for the wheels, 2 thin boxes for the shafts (or one convex hull overall)
variants.notes: Floor 5 planks, side walls 2+2 planks, front wall with broken upper plank, low back plank, 4 corner posts, 16 pegs, axle, 2 sills, 2 shafts, 2 faceted 14-sided solid wheels with hex hubs: all separate geometry. Empty body; seeds/sacks are separate assets. Damaged variant = rotate/chip a wheel in the level.
